name: The Atlanta Journal-Constitution editorial board
lean_basis: Georgia's largest newspaper. The AJC announced in 2009 that it would no longer endorse political candidates, saying readers 'don't need the paper to tell them how to vote' (Editor & Publisher). It publishes voter guides and explainers instead. AllSides rates its news coverage Lean Left. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/atlanta-journal-constitution-media-bias.

name: League of Women Voters of Georgia (VOTE411)
lean_basis: League of Women Voters chapter that describes itself as 'a nonpartisan, grassroots nonprofit dedicated to empowering everyone to fully participate in our democracy' (https://lwvga.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Democratic Party of Georgia
lean_basis: Official state party organization. Its county affiliates (Fulton County Democrats) publish the statewide nominee slate.

name: Georgia Republican Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization; publishes a 2026 statewide candidate guide of its nominees.

name: Georgia Chamber of Commerce
lean_basis: Statewide chamber of commerce whose stated mission is 'To empower and support Georgia’s businesses and communities, driving prosperity and growth through unwavering advocacy' (https://www.gachamber.com/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: NFIB Georgia PAC (National Federation of Independent Business)
lean_basis: AllSides rates the National Federation of Independent Business Lean Right (think tank/policy group; low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). This is NFIB's Georgia PAC. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/national-federation-independent-business-media-bias.

name: Sierra Club Georgia Chapter
lean_basis: AllSides rates the national Sierra Club Lean Left (think tank/policy group; independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). This is its Georgia chapter. Rating source: https://www.allsides.com/news-source/sierra-club-media-bias.

name: Planned Parenthood Action Fund / Planned Parenthood Southeast Advocates
lean_basis: Abortion-rights political arm of Planned Parenthood. It says it works to 'defend reproductive rights' (https://www.plannedparenthoodaction.org/about-us). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Georgia Equality PAC
lean_basis: LGBTQ+ rights PAC of Georgia Equality, which says it is 'dedicated to advancing the rights of LGBTQ+ Georgians and all those living with HIV throughout Georgia' (https://georgiaequality.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Fair Fight
lean_basis: Voting-rights group whose site is headed 'Fighting Voter Suppression & Protecting Voting Rights' (https://www.fairfight.com/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Georgia Fraternal Order of Police
lean_basis: Police union whose own description, that it is 'committed to improving the working conditions of law enforcement officers and the safety of those we serve' (https://www.georgiafop.org/about), uses no ideological language. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: LIBRE State PAC
lean_basis: State PAC of the LIBRE Initiative, which says it works to 'vigorously advocate for freedom-minded solutions' (https://thelibreinitiative.com/about-us/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Georgia Farm Bureau
lean_basis: Farm lobby whose stated charge is 'to be a voice for Georgia agriculture' (https://www.gfb.org/); it does not endorse. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Professional Association of Georgia Educators (PAGE)
lean_basis: Educators' professional association (not a union) that says it was 'established as an independent, non-partisan association' (https://www.pageinc.org/about-page) and does not endorse candidates. No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: NRA Political Victory Fund
lean_basis: Gun-rights PAC of the National Rifle Association, which calls itself 'a single issue organization' that grades candidates on 'Second Amendment issues' (https://www.nrapvf.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Georgia AFL-CIO
lean_basis: The state labor federation says it strengthens the voice of working families by advocating for workers' rights and protections (https://georgiaaflcio.org/). No outside rating found; lean follows its stated mission.

name: Georgia Association of Educators Fund for Public Education
lean_basis: The educators' PAC says it recommends and supports public education champions; GAE describes a mission of public education, opportunity and inclusion (https://gae.org/votes). No outside rating found; lean follows that stated mission.
